description.zh: Hunyuan3D / Meshy 等 provider 的 3D 资产生成入口：选 provider + 输入，产出持久化的游戏可用 3D 资产 manifest。
description.en: 3D asset generation entrypoint for providers like Hunyuan3D and Meshy: pick a provider and input, produce durable game-ready 3D asset manifests.

description.zh: 读取 3D 生成供应商能力矩阵；返回静态、无配额数据。
description.en: Read the 3D generation provider capability matrix. Returns static no-quota data.

description.zh: 列出当前游戏已生成的持久化 3D 资产 manifest，可按 slot / provider 过滤。
description.en: List the active game's durable 3D asset manifests, optionally filtered by slot / provider.

description.zh: 删除当前游戏的一个 3D 资产（主 GLB + sidecar + 同名附属文件），并对其 cacheKey 打 tombstone 防止缓存复活。破坏性操作，仅经 UI 确认触发。
description.en: Delete a 3D asset from the active game (main GLB + sidecar + same-basename sidefiles) and tombstone its cacheKey so it never resurrects from a cache hit. Destructive; UI-confirm only.

description.zh: 生成确定性的 Meshy 文生 3D mock 资产并落盘为持久 manifest；不调用远端。
description.en: Generate a deterministic Meshy text-to-3D mock asset persisted as a durable manifest, with no remote calls.

description.zh: 文生 3D：选 provider（混元 workflow / Meshy / Rodin）生成并落盘持久 manifest（cache-first）。未配置真实 provider 时回退确定性 mock，保持无配额安全。
description.en: Text-to-3D via the chosen provider (Hunyuan workflow / Meshy / Rodin), persisted as a durable manifest (cache-first). Falls back to a deterministic mock when no real provider is configured (quota-safe).

description.zh: 图生 3D：选 provider（混元 workflow / Meshy / Rodin）生成并落盘持久 manifest（cache-first）。未配置真实 provider 时回退确定性 mock。
description.en: Image-to-3D via the chosen provider (Hunyuan workflow / Meshy / Rodin), persisted as a durable manifest (cache-first). Falls back to a deterministic mock when no real provider is configured.

description.zh: 多视图生 3D：选 provider（Hunyuan workflow 命名视图槽 / Meshy 有序图数组 / Rodin concat 多图）生成并落盘持久 manifest（cache-first）。未配置真实 provider 时回退确定性 mock。
description.en: Multi-view-to-3D via the chosen provider (Hunyuan workflow named view slots / Meshy ordered image array / Rodin concat multi-image), persisted as a durable manifest (cache-first). Falls back to a deterministic mock when no real provider is configured.

description.zh: 精修网格（Meshy 专属第二阶段）：对一个 Meshy 文生 preview 任务加贴图，落盘新的持久 manifest（mode=refine，cache-first）。未配置 Meshy 时回退确定性 mock。
description.en: Refine mesh (Meshy-only second stage): add texture to a Meshy text preview task, persisted as a new durable manifest (mode=refine, cache-first). Falls back to a deterministic mock when Meshy is not configured.

description.zh: 姿态标准化（Hunyuan REST 子能力，上游预处理）：把简单卡通人物全身图标准化为 A/T-pose，输出图落盘为持久 blob 供后续图生 3D 使用；不产出 3D 资产 manifest。未配置真实 provider 时回退确定性 mock。
description.en: Pose standardization (Hunyuan REST sub-capability, upstream preprocessing): standardize a simple cartoon full-body character image to an A/T-pose. The output image is persisted as a durable blob for later image-to-3D; it does NOT produce a 3D asset manifest. Falls back to a deterministic mock when no real provider is configured.

description.zh: 本地图片上传（中转产物，非资产）：解码 base64（≤8MB）上传到 COS，返回 24h 预签名 URL 供图生/多视图/姿态标准化等 URL-fetch provider 使用。未配置 COS 时报错，提示改为手填 URL。
description.en: Local image upload (transfer artifact, NOT an asset): decode base64 (≤8MB), upload to COS, return a 24h presigned URL for URL-fetching providers (image/views/pose tools). Errors with cos_not_configured when COS is absent so the UI can ask the user to paste a URL.

description.zh: 自动绑骨（ADR-0006，公测默认 Meshy 公网 API）：把一个带贴图的高模角色 GLB 自动绑定人形骨架，向同一资产追加 rigged_model 的 GLB（自包含，保贴图）+ FBX（供动作迁移）及随附的免费走/跑片段，并记录 rig-chain（rig_task_id/rigType/过期）、置位 readiness.rigged。Dispatch：Meshy 公网默认 → Hunyuan REST 内网兜底 → mock。仅人形角色；幂等。真实配额需运营 Gate 真机验证 + 签字，故 exposedToAI=false（本期不开放给 AI）。
description.en: Auto-rig (ADR-0006; public-beta default is the Meshy public API): rig a textured high-poly character GLB with a humanoid skeleton, appending a rigged_model GLB (self-contained, textures preserved) + FBX plus any bundled free walk/run clips to the SAME asset, recording the rig-chain (rig_task_id/rigType/expiry) and flipping readiness.rigged. Dispatch: Meshy public default → Hunyuan REST internal fallback → mock. Humanoid only; idempotent. Real quota needs operator Gate verification + sign-off, so exposedToAI=false (not exposed to the AI this round).

description.zh: 应用动作（ADR-0006）：对一个已绑骨资产应用一个动作，向同一资产追加 animated_model 的 GLB+FBX（保贴图），并置位 readiness.animated。按资产记录的绑骨系统分发：Meshy（公测默认）用 list-motions 选出的 actionId + 资产自己的 rig_task_id 驱动 /animations，rig 过期可选 autoReRig 重绑；Hunyuan（内网）用固定动作 motionType 9–16。需先 auto-rig；多动作并存，按动作幂等。真实配额需运营 Gate 签字，故 exposedToAI=false。
description.en: Apply motion (ADR-0006): apply one motion to a rigged asset, appending an animated_model GLB+FBX (textures preserved) to the SAME asset and flipping readiness.animated. Dispatched by the asset's recorded rig system: Meshy (public-beta default) uses an actionId picked from gen3d:list-motions + the asset's OWN rig_task_id to drive /animations (optional autoReRig re-rigs an expired task); Hunyuan (internal) uses fixed motionType 9–16. Requires prior auto-rig; multiple motions coexist, idempotent per motion. Real quota needs operator Gate sign-off, so exposedToAI=false.

description.zh: 列出可用动作（ADR-0006 §两步选择）：返回某资产绑骨系统对应的动作目录的过滤切片——Hunyuan 绑骨→v1 固定 8 个；Meshy 绑骨→其 rig 兼容 / 公共目录（~680）。零配额（GET），未配 Meshy 时返回确定性 mock 样本。schema 不枚举全量，调用方用 query/category/rigType 收窄。供动作浏览器与 apply-motion 选 actionId 使用；与绑骨/动作同处一个未开放特性，故暂 exposedToAI=false。
description.en: List motions (ADR-0006 two-step selection): return a filtered slice of the motion catalog for an asset's rig system — Hunyuan-rigged → the v1 fixed 8; Meshy-rigged → its rig-compatible / public catalog (~680). Zero quota (a GET); a deterministic mock sample when Meshy is unconfigured. The schema never enumerates the full set — callers narrow via query/category/rigType. Feeds the motion browser + actionId selection for apply-motion; part of the same un-exposed feature, so exposedToAI=false for now.

description.zh: 低模重拓扑（Hunyuan REST low_poly，M13，可选侧支）：把高模 GLB 重拓扑为低模，产出一个全新的衍生低模 GLB 资产（cache-first），高模源保留。注意：贴图不保留，因此不是绑骨前的预处理步骤。Gate 0 真机验证（Hunyuan 内网可达公网 COS）通过前默认 mock，exposedToAI=false。
description.en: Retopo low-poly (Hunyuan REST low_poly, M13, optional side-branch): retopologize a high-poly GLB to low-poly, producing a NEW derived low-poly GLB asset (cache-first); the high-poly source is retained. Note: textures are NOT preserved, so this is NOT a pre-rig step. Mock-only until Gate 0 real-machine verification (Hunyuan internal egress can fetch public COS) passes, so exposedToAI=false.

description.zh: 质量评分（按需混合，ADR-0004）：合并客户端客观启发式 + 人工覆盖（AI 视觉评本期为 mock 桩）写入资产 sidecar 的 quality 报告，返回更新后的 manifest。lazy 持久化：浏览不写盘，仅评分/覆盖时落库。
description.en: Score quality (on-demand hybrid, ADR-0004): merge client objective heuristics + manual overrides (AI vision is a mock stub this round) into the asset sidecar quality report and return the updated manifest. Lazy persistence: browsing never writes; only scoring/override persists.

description.zh: 设置资产的用户自定义显示名（userLabel）。传 null 或空字符串可清除，恢复自动名称（prompt 首行或文件名 stem）。
description.en: Set a user-defined display label (userLabel) on an asset. Pass null or empty string to clear and revert to the auto-name (prompt first line or filename stem).

description.zh: 读取三家供应商凭证的掩码配置状态（不返回明文）。
description.en: Read the masked configuration state of the three providers' credentials (never returns plaintext).

description.zh: 写入/更新供应商 key 与总开关到插件本地 .env 并即时生效（无需重启）。
description.en: Write/update provider keys and the master switch to the plugin-local .env and apply them live (no server restart needed).
